 assert len(sys.argv)==4;args+=['-ValidateCatalog']

 compiled=prep['sourceHead'];delta=git('diff','--name-only',compiled,expected).decode().splitlines();assert all(p.startswith('specs/1558-remove-daren-campaign/') for p in delta)
 args+=['-SelectionFile','tests/selections/1558-daren-retirement-red-remaining.json','-PlanOnly','-NoBuild']
result_root=root/'TestResults/test-categories';old=set(result_root.iterdir()) if result_root.exists() else set()

def roots():return sorted(str(p) for pattern in prefixes for p in Path(tempfile.gettempdir()).glob(pattern))

marker=out.parent/(expected+'-s04-'+mode+'.first-launch.json')
with marker.open('x') as f:json.dump(dict(kind='FIRST_S04_PREPARATION_SENTINEL',mode=mode,sourceHead=expected,compiledSource=compiled,label=label,createdUtc=start,recordPath=str(out/'record.json')),f,indent=2)
with (out/'stdout.log').open('wb') as stream:
 process=subprocess.Popen(args,cwd=root,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 (out/'process.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(pid=process.pid,argv=args,startedUtc=start),indent=2)+'\n')
 nativeExit=process.wait()
elapsed=time.monotonic()-clock;new=sorted(str(p) for p in set(result_root.iterdir())-old) if result_root.exists() else []
after=binaries();head_after=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip();status=git('status','--porcelain').decode()
j=dict(mode=mode,label=label,argv=args,cwd=str(root),sourceHead=expected,compiledSource=compiled,productSource='46ff637a01390a27c45a7fc36dc30e31d688e499',startedUtc=start,finishedUtc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),wallSeconds=elapsed,nativeExit=nativeExit,stdoutPath=str(out/'stdout.log'),stdoutSha256=hashlib.sha256((out/'stdout.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),resultDirectories=new,binaryBefore=before,binaryAfter=after,headAfter=head_after,statusAfter=status,ownedPrefixesBefore=prefix_before,ownedPrefixesAfter=roots(),helperText=Path(__file__).read_text(),runtimeScope='FRESH S04 BOTH/catalog or exact remaining21 selection PlanOnly; ZERO test/capture/consumer/host/browser execution',authority='Existing Root G1 preparation authorization; no actual permission, source/evidence verdict, retry mechanism or production release inferred.')
j.update(sourceBindingPath=str(binding_path.relative_to(root)),sourceBindingSha256=hashlib.sha256(binding_bytes).hexdigest(),processRecord=str(out/'process.json'),firstLaunchSentinel=str(marker))
(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(j,indent=2)+'\n')
print('LOCAL_GM1558_G1_EXIT',nativeExit,'wall',round(elapsed,3),'results',new,'record',out/'record.json',flush=True)
assert head_after==expected and not status
